summary: The best entry points are Miami's Podcast (open guest application at miamispodcast.com/be-a-guest), The Shrimp Tank in Boca (open guest form; active in 2026 with Stuart Weitzman and the Hard Rock president), and the art-native Art & Company and Wynwood Magazine podcasts. These are followed by Your Luxe Lifestyle (high-net-worth audience) and The #MiamiTech Pod (run by Refresh Miami, an ecosystem connection). The middle rung is the Miami luxury real-estate shows (Cervera's Miami Real Estate Podcast, David Siddons), I Am Athlete and The Come Up Miami for culture, then The Cardone Zone and The Pomp Podcast, which already book Miami celebrities and moguls and draw a national audience. Upward track evidence was NOT verified: the search budget ran out before guest-crossover searches (e.g. Shrimp Tank or I Am Athlete guests later on PBD, Rogan or Modern Wisdom). The only crossover seen is David Grutman, who appeared on I Am Athlete, The Cardone Zone, WY Network and Speed of Culture, and none of those are on the target list. Booking emails were deliberately not collected or constructed. Pay-to-play status is unknown for every show.
